summary: Steel Strips Infrastructures Limited held its 53rd AGM on September 30, 2026, adopting FY26 financial statements and reappointing key directors including Sanjay Garg as MD.

headline: Sonata Software closes trading window for Q2FY27
summary: Sonata Software Ltd has closed its trading window from October 1, 2026, ahead of the declaration of financial results for the quarter and half year ending September 30, 2026.
